components.name: Beyond Borders heading
components.description: Solid, uppercase two-line heading inherited from the dark Kanit portfolio.
components.css: .ds-global-heading { margin:0; color:var(--mist); font-family:var(--font-kanit), Kanit, sans-serif; font-size:clamp(3.5rem,6.5vw,6rem); font-weight:900; line-height:0.9; letter-spacing:-0.035em; text-transform:uppercase; }

components.name: Certificate link
components.description: Underlined evidence link with visible keyboard focus and a 44px minimum target.
components.html: View exchange certificate
components.css: .ds-global-link { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; min-height:44px; font-family:var(--font-kanit), Kanit, sans-serif; font-size:0.9rem; color:var(--mist); text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:5px; text-decoration-color:#778793; transition:color 180ms ease; } .ds-global-link:hover { color:#ffffff; } .ds-global-link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--mist); outline-offset:5px; }

narrative.overview: Photo-led exchange section for admissions and job applications: heading, exchange context, first-day, presentation, and group photographs, and exchange certificate only.
keyCharacteristics: Aligned rectangular collage: full first-day strip at left, presentation and group stacked at right; preserve this arrangement on mobile.
Brief context only; no achievement slogans or classroom-score claims.
Existing dark background and solid Kanit heading.
dos: Keep text brief and original photos prominent.
Retain every person horizontally in the group photo and keep certificate links visible.
donts: Do not restore the three takeaway blocks or classroom-score claims.
Do not rotate, skew, stretch, or perspective-correct the first-day photograph. Preserve its original proportions and composition.
